data.title: Has Claude Opus 5.5 Actually Been Nerfed? What the Last Three Days Show — abZ Global
data.description: Has Claude Opus 5.5 Actually Been Nerfed?  Claude Opus 5.5 is Anthropic's current flagship Opus model, released on September 22, 2026. Over the last three days, a noticeable group of users on X has claimed that something changed.  The complaints are familiar to anyone who follows frontier AI release
